title: Large language models for partial differential equation workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.03600v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Numerical methods and deep learning have advanced the modelling and simulation of systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), while formulating equations, configuring solvers, and translating simulations into design and control decisions continue to demand substantial domain expertise and computational resources. Large language models (LLMs) offer opportunities to automate and coordinate these tasks by combining scientific knowledge, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and tool use. Here we review LLM-assisted PDE research across three stages, including discovery, solving, and optimization. We examine how LLMs interact with physical knowledge, numerical methods, and computational feedback to formulate models, implement solution procedures, and guide design and control. We also review existing benchmarks and evaluation practices for assessing scientific validity, computational performance, and workflow reliability.

translated_title: 大语言模型在偏微分方程工作流中的应用
translated_abstract: 数值方法和深度学习已经推动了由偏微分方程（PDE）支配的系统的建模与仿真，然而方程的构建、求解器的配置以及将仿真结果转化为设计与控制决策，仍然需要大量的领域专业知识和计算资源。大语言模型（LLM）通过结合科学知识、数学推理、代码生成和工具使用，为自动化和协调这些任务提供了机会。本文综述了LLM辅助的偏微分方程研究在三个阶段的应用，包括发现、求解和优化。我们考察了LLM如何与物理知识、数值方法和计算反馈交互，以构建模型、实现求解过程并指导设计与控制。我们还综述了用于评估科学有效性、计算性能和工作流可靠性的现有基准测试和评估实践。
tldr: 本文系统综述了大语言模型在偏微分方程工作流中辅助模型发现、方程求解和设计优化三个阶段的研究进展，并总结了评估科学有效性、计算性能和工作流可靠性的基准测试方法。
